description: During my three-year tenure as a Systems Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), I worked exclusively on a high-priority cloud migration project for a global media conglomerate, serving as an AWS Developer. The project involved migrating over 15 critical applications from legacy data centers to Amazon Web Services, leveraging AWS Managed Services (AMS) for secure, compliant, and accelerated delivery. I led an 8-member infrastructure team from the TCS side, ensuring 100% on-time deployment with zero data loss. My responsibilities included AWS Cloud Development, DevOps automation, architecture diagram design, and cross-functional coordination with application and database teams. The solutions we implemented significantly reduced downtime and improved scalability, enhancing client satisfaction across the UK, US, and Brazil. I was honored with the “Star of the Quarter” award and rated in the top 10% of professionals at my level by senior leadership.
